findings: Index.html and internal.html define inline theme switching logic alongside js/theme-darkmode.js which creates duplicated state management.

js/theme-darkmode.js sets `isDarkMode = false` initially and flips it during initTheme. It relies on window.StorageModule but local storage calls inside index.html and internal.html use native `localStorage` directly.

The theme toggle button `#btn-toggle-theme` in both index.html and internal.html changes state via `toggleDarkMode()` from js/theme-darkmode.js, but index.html also has an inline listener for `#theme-toggle` that duplicates tile swapping logic.
CartoDB basemaps (light_all and dark_all) are hardcoded in index.html, internal.html, and js/theme-darkmode.js.

Carto CDN may be deprecated or require a paid plan, an alternative like Stadia Maps (Alidade Smooth / Alidade Smooth Dark) or Jawg Maps could be a replacement, but for now we observe CartoDB dependencies.
In internal.html, labels (Dark) and (Light) colors are defined in the config UI but Leaflet overlay text might not automatically invert or adjust its color based on the current theme.
CSS `body.dark-theme [style*="color: #64748b"]` is used for WCAG AA contrast fix on dimmed text, however dynamic text generated by Leaflet (like tooltips or popups) might still lack contrast.
The `#btn-toggle-theme` button maintains internal state and uses `btn-outline-dark` which might not provide enough contrast in dark mode against a dark surface.
Button text changes between '🌙 Dark Mode' and '☀️ Light Mode', but inline `themeToggle` logic uses '☀️' and '🌙' emojis independently.

recommendations: Remove inline theme switching logic from index.html and internal.html and strictly use js/theme-darkmode.js to manage state.
Unify `#btn-toggle-theme` and `#theme-toggle` logic to rely purely on `window.toggleDarkMode()`.
Evaluate Carto tile alternatives and replace URLs in `js/theme-darkmode.js` and HTML files if necessary.
Update Leaflet popup and tooltip CSS for dark mode to ensure dynamic overlay text maintains WCAG AA contrast.
Adjust button classes for `#btn-toggle-theme` in dark mode to `btn-outline-light` dynamically, or use a neutral class.
